crossRefs.note: But I am a worm, and no man; a reproach of men, and despised by the people.
Yes, for your sake we are killed all day long. We are regarded as sheep for the slaughter.
Yahweh, you know. Remember me, visit me, and avenge me of my persecutors. You are patient, so don’t take me away. Know…
But they will do all these things to you for my name’s sake, because they don’t know him who sent me.
I gave my back to those who beat me, and my cheeks to those who plucked off the hair. I didn’t hide my face from shame…
He was despised and rejected by men, a man of suffering and acquainted with disease. He was despised as one from whom…
Then they spat in his face and beat him with their fists, and some slapped him,
saying, “Prophesy to us, you Christ! Who hit you?”
They braided a crown of thorns and put it on his head, and a reed in his right hand; and they kneeled down before him…
They spat on him, and took the reed and struck him on the head.
Then there were two robbers crucified with him, one on his right hand and one on the left.
Herod with his soldiers humiliated him and mocked him. Dressing him in luxurious clothing, they sent him back to Pilate.
The people stood watching. The rulers with them also scoffed at him, saying, “He saved others. Let him save himself, if…
looking to Jesus, the author and perfecter of faith, who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross…

translations.web: Because for your sake, I have borne reproach. Shame has covered my face.
translations.bsb: For I have endured scorn for Your sake, and shame has covered my face.
translations.kjv: Because for thy sake I have borne reproach; shame hath covered my face.
translations.asv: Because for thy sake I have borne reproach; Shame hath covered my face.
